name: devscope-live
description: DevScope in the live session: team prompt suggestions, team skills, a stuck band, outcome labels and session-to-commit links

nextPrompts.title: Team prompt suggestions
nextPrompts.description: Suggest a short next step (a few words) that worked in several similar sessions, only after Claude did work and did not ask you something

teamSkills.title: Team skills
teamSkills.description: Offer your team's approved skills when a prompt matches one

stuckBand.title: Stuck band
stuckBand.description: Show a band with options when Claude keeps failing the same way

outcomeLabels.title: Outcome labels
outcomeLabels.description: Record whether turns worked, from your replies and an occasional question after long turns

commitLinks.title: Commit and PR links
commitLinks.description: Record the commits and PRs a session makes, and whether its PRs merged (checked with gh)

voiceProgress.title: Voice progress bar
voiceProgress.description: Show a progress bar above the prompt while DevScope voice creates or speaks audio (/devscope:voice explain, reply summaries)

commitTrailer.title: DevScope-Session trailer
commitTrailer.description: Add a DevScope-Session line to Claude's commit messages and PR descriptions
